links.outcome: Factual adherence and context drift of LLM outputs when grounded in structured EMR data and RAG
links.effect: Abstract reports the architecture eliminates semantic context drift, prevents database compilation crashes, and improves factual adherence to backend clinical repositories. No numeric results are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Validation shows that this architecture eliminates semantic context drift, prevents database compilation crashes, and improves factual adherence to backend clinical repositories.

unlisted_practices: Deterministic ground-truth injection of the latest structured EMR state into the LLM prompt before generation
Hierarchical intent routing of queries to deterministic analytics versus RAG reasoning
Deterministic protocol manager mapping clinical terminology to fixed evidence-based risk pathways

screen.reason: The paper empirically validates an architectural clinical decision support system incorporating deterministic safeguards, retrieval grounding, and output phrase filtering to ensure clinical safety and factual adherence.

primary.practice: ground truth injection module and safety verifier phrase filtering
